displayPattern: Status LED: 1 short flash(es) then 3 long flash(es) (code 13)
meaning: Limit circuit lockout: a limit or flame rollout switch was open longer than 3 minutes. Control auto-resets after 3 hours (see code 33).
causes: Dirty filter or restricted duct system
Restricted vent or improper vent sizing
Inadequate combustion air supply (flame rollout switch open)
diySteps: Turn off power and check/replace a dirty air filter
Make sure return and supply grilles are open and unobstructed
Technician: check vent sizing and restrictions, blower wheel, blower motor/capacitor, switches and connections
Technician: flame rollout switch requires manual reset only after the cause is found
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the furnace locks out again after replacing the filter, or if a rollout switch has tripped.
